capabilities: Move, indent, and outdent heading sections and list subtrees
Reorganize blocks by drag and drop in an Outline Tree View
Edit a focused section or subtree in a Partial Edit Pane
Copy, duplicate, and paste blocks within the same note
Create and manage same-note embeds (mirrors) of headings and blocks
disambiguation: Despite the name, it works on one note at a time and never moves or copies content between notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; beta releases can be installed via BRAT, and the README documents current boundaries and safe-use limits in detail.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Outline is excellent for navigating headings.
motivation: The author built it for the point where the built-in Outline and list-focused outliner plugins are both needed in the same note: reorganizing heading sections and nested list structures as visible, safe units.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Outline only navigates headings and list-focused outliner plugins only handle list items, leaving no tool to reorganize both as safe units in one note.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's built-in Outline is excellent for navigating headings.
Install the Style Settings community plugin to customize the Outline Tree View's appearance

summary: Structural editor that moves, re-levels, copies, and edits heading sections and list subtrees within a single Obsidian note.
